title: Urgent Private Talks: Land, Lawsuits, & Staff
summary:
*   An emergency private meeting was held to discuss sensitive city issues behind closed doors.
*   Discussions focused on potential land acquisitions, active lawsuits, and confidential personnel matters, including a specific W.I.C. investigation.
*   No public actions, votes, or policy decisions were made during this special session.
